role_asks.shieldbearer: Front-line wall. How heavy should the armor and shield look?
role_asks.spearman: Second rank with long reach. Light or medium armor?
role_asks.swordsman: Main melee fighter. The race's typical soldier.
role_asks.captain: Leader who rallies troops. Should stand out: banner, cape, crest, bigger build?
role_asks.champion: The race's hero with a unique ability. Should be the most distinct unit of the race.
role_asks.archer: Back-rank ranged unit. Hood, quiver, robes?

questions.question: Reference images for each race's soldiers.
questions.why: Every unit marked Needs input uses the plain race skin. Pictures or descriptions let me give each one its own model, gear and size.

questions.question: How should each Champion look?
questions.why: Paladin, Bladedancer, Ironbreaker, Berserker, Hellknight, Seraph and Ravager all have abilities but no design yet.

questions.question: Which units should be bigger or smaller than the rest?
questions.why: Sizes today come only from the race (dwarves 0.85×, orcs 1.10×) plus imps at 0.7×. Brutes, champions or captains could be larger.

questions.question: Should the other demons (Hellguard, Fiend, Archfiend, Blood Witch) be a species of their own?
questions.why: Imps are now one species. The full-sized demons need a look: horned humanoids, armored knights, something else?

questions.question: Should players of other races get their own player model, like demons do?
questions.why: Only demon players look different. Angels with wings, dwarves shorter, hive with carapace are all possible.

questions.question: Should the enemy factions look different from the player races beyond color?
questions.why: The Black Legion, Marauders and the others reuse their race's models with their own colors.

questions.question: Any look in mind for the Mana Well, Pylon, Summoning Altar and Braziers?
questions.why: I'm building a first version now. Reference images would let me match your style.

questions.question: Should Captains and Champions need a bigger altar, or be limited to one each?
questions.why: Right now any complete altar can summon every role if the mana is there.

questions.question: Do you want more tower types, or a new look for the existing three?
questions.why: Arrow Tower, Arcane Spire and Healing Shrine are simple textured blocks.

questions.question: Twilight Forest is CurseForge-only. Skip it, or pick a replacement?
questions.why: The pack is built from Modrinth, so it can't include Twilight Forest.

settled.answer: Imps are one demon species. They only fill the Impaler and Firecaster roles.
Builders, farmers and guards look plain and humanoid in every race.
Mana is base power: wells store it, pylons extend range, towers and the altar draw from it. No personal mana bar.
Manabloom grows shards (everyday fuel); mana ore gives crystals (dense fuel and building material).
Units are summoned at a multiblock altar with a menu.
Oryx-style head, bare hands and feet, wings that fold at the elbow, flight without an elytra.
